Krishna Bhajans

The bhajan player streams these videos from YouTube in YouTube’s own embedded player (youtube-nocookie.com), under the YouTube Terms of Service. Nothing is downloaded or hosted on this site; each video plays only while its uploader allows embedding, and belongs to its channel. The words are traditional (Meera Bai, Surdas); the recordings and arrangements belong to their performers and labels.

  1. Shri Krishna Govind Hare Murari — Ravindra Jain. Uploaded by Ravindra Jain.
  2. Govind Bolo Hari Gopal Bolo — Lata Mangeshkar (film Johny Mera Naam, 1970). Uploaded by Shemaroo Musical Maestros.
  3. Mere To Giridhar Gopal — Amrita Chaturvedi. Uploaded by Amrita Chaturvedi – Topic (provided to YouTube by Phonographic Digital Limited).
  4. Maiya Mori Main Nahi Makhan Khayo — M. S. Subbulakshmi. Uploaded by Saregama Hindustani Classical.
  5. Akhiyan Hari Darshan Ki Pyasi — Eshita Bhattacharjya & Babita Chakraborty. Uploaded by Culture Circle.
  6. Baso Mere Nainan Mein Nandlal — Arundhati Roychoudhury. Uploaded by Bhakti Amrit – FFR.
  7. Pag Ghungroo Bandh Meera Naachi Re — Alka Yagnik. Uploaded by Shemaroo Bhakti.
  8. Jo Tum Todo Piya Main Nahi Todun — Sri Sathya Sai devotional singers. Uploaded by Sri Sathya Sai Official.
  9. Madhuban Tum Kyon Rehat Hare — M. S. Subbulakshmi. Uploaded by Saregama Carnatic Classical.
  10. Hari Tum Haro Jan Ki Peer — Ram Swaroop Das (live). Uploaded by Ram Sagar creation.

Sounds · Kitchen Calm

Every sound is a real recording used under the licence shown. For the website each file was trimmed, levelled to a consistent quiet volume, given gentle fade-ins and fade-outs, and re-encoded as AAC.

  • Flute & Stillness — “Bansuri sample E bass” by a Wikimedia Commons contributor (own work), Wikimedia Commons, public domain; mixed with a quiet bed of “River in the forest with birds”, Mixkit (sound #1216), Mixkit Sound Effects Free License.
  • Greeting chime — “Wind chimes”, Mixkit (sound #2014), Mixkit Sound Effects Free License.
  • Cooked bell — “Relaxing bell chime”, Mixkit (sound #3109), Mixkit Sound Effects Free License.
